text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — I dumped the action list below. Can owners confirm or update due dates by EOD? Trying to get a clean handoff to sprint planning.

alex: I can take the trace retention change. Targeting 3/28 for the PR, unless there's unexpected churn.

diego: I'll own the rollback safe-mode doc. Need until next Tue (4/1) to finish the checklist and tests.

jen: For the alert tuning (too many false positives) — pairing with infra next week. Can we set a tentative due 3/31?

sam: Recording: I'll validate the canary policy and add automated alerting for capacity spikes. PR by 3/29.

mona: I'll run the customer-impact writeup and verification steps; can take until 4/3 due to interviews with CS.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-042: postmortem actions updated by sara. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-042/postmortem

sara: Great — can everyone paste a one-liner status update when you have it. If a due date slips, note blocker and new ETA.

alex: one-liner: PR in progress, awaiting infra review. ETA 2026-03-28.

diego: one-liner: drafting doc, need test infra. Blocker: access to test GPU queue (ticket #4572). New ETA 2026-04-01.

jen: one-liner: alert rules updated locally, validating for 48h. No blockers. ETA 2026-03-31.

sam: one-liner: canary tests passing on staging, adding autoscaler check. ETA 2026-03-29.

mona: one-liner: collecting CS notes, will synthesize mitigations. ETA 2026-04-03.

sara: Thanks — I'll compile and assign follow-ups to sprint board. If anyone needs help accelerating (extra reviewer, docs review), ping me or @alex.

alex: @sara please add me to the sprint ticket so I get the reviewer reminder. :+1:

jen: tagging eng-oncall for any rollout timing constraints. @eng-oncall can you confirm no maintenance window conflicts for 3/29-4/03?

eng-oncall (sam): No scheduled maintenance in that window. If rollouts need off-hours, call it out and we'll coordinate.

sara: Updated the postmortem action block with owners/ETAs and linked tickets. Will re-open thread if dates change. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

(note: action list copied from the doc)

```
- A1: Trace retention config - owner: alex - ETA: 2026-03-28 - ticket: #4548
- A2: Rollback safe-mode checklist - owner: diego - ETA: 2026-04-01 - ticket: #4552
- A3: Alert tuning and de-dupe - owner: jen - ETA: 2026-03-31 - ticket: #4561
- A4: Canary policy + autoscaler checks - owner: sam - ETA: 2026-03-29 - ticket: #4565
- A5: Customer impact writeup & verification - owner: mona - ETA: 2026-04-03 - ticket: #4570
```
